response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior full-stack engineer with solid fundamentals, some high-scale distributed systems exposure, and recent AI-tooling work. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on experimentation platforms, telemetry, metrics, feature flighting, and statistical rigor — none of which appear in the resume. There is also no demonstrated principal-level scope such as leading multi-team initiatives or building platforms adopted across many teams, making the seniority and domain fit weak despite strong general engineering skills.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD)
High-scale systems exposure: low-latency microservices handling millions of HTTP requests per second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Recent hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work, plus open-source leadership and community teaching
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience — the core of this role
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure ownership or statistical/experimental analysis skills
Career trajectory is senior IC on product teams; no demonstrated principal-level, multi-workstream, cross-org technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and high-scale systems background
